repo.name: RedTerm
repo.description: This is a repository of apps to be used with F-Droid. Applications in this repository are either official binaries built by the original application developers, or are binaries built from source by the admin of f-droid.org using the tools on https://gitlab.com/fdroid.

apps.description:
RedTerm is a full terminal environment for Android. It installs real Linux
distributions into a proot sandbox and gives you a working shell, package
manager and file system on your phone, with no root required.

Included:

* A dozen distributions: Alpine, Debian, Ubuntu, Kali, Fedora, Rocky,
  AlmaLinux, Void, Arch, Manjaro and openSUSE, for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a,
  x86_64 and x86.
* A built-in OpenSSH client and server, so you can reach a machine over SSH
  without installing anything first.
* A built-in terminal emulator with configurable extra keys, ANSI colour,
  multiple sessions and split panes.
* A file manager with previews for text, images, audio and video.
* Backup and restore of a whole distribution to shared storage, so a
  distribution survives reinstalling the app.
* Recording of terminal sessions, disk usage, package updates, base image
  updates and an in-app log for diagnosing problems.

No root, no cloud account and no data leaving your device.
